blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Yesterday the delivery was on time. The pallets were ready in the morning. The team was fast, and the customers were happy.

"Was" and "were" are the past of "to be". We use them to talk about yesterday, last week, or two days ago.

Today you learn 5 important words and practise was / were. We start slow. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: When was the delivery on time?
items.why: "Yesterday the delivery was on time." — foi ontem.

items.q: How were the customers?
items.why: "the customers were happy" — eles estavam felizes.

items.q: "Was" and "were" are the past of…
items.why: "Was" and "were" are the past of "to be".

items.q: The text suggests that the day was…
items.why: Inferência: entrega no horário, time rápido e clientes felizes = um bom dia.

items.q: The author would most likely say that you…
items.why: Inferência: "You can do it!" e "English comes in CAN's" — a mensagem é positiva.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Maria falar com o gerente sobre a entrega de ontem. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. I want to tell you about yesterday.

Yesterday the delivery was good. The truck was here at eight. The pallets were ready, and the boxes were clean. My team was fast. We were happy.

Last week we had a problem. The truck was late, and the customers were not happy. But yesterday was different. Everything was on time.

Two days ago I was worried. Today I am calm. The customers were happy, and the manager was happy too.

Thank you for your help. See you tomorrow.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time was the truck there yesterday?
items.why: "The truck was here at eight."

items.q: How were the pallets?
items.why: "The pallets were ready."

items.q: What was the problem last week?
items.why: "Last week… The truck was late, and the customers were not happy."

items.q: The speaker suggests that yesterday was…
items.why: Inferência: semana passada teve problema, mas "yesterday was different… on time" — foi melhor.

items.q: How does the speaker feel now?
items.why: Inferência: "Two days ago I was worried. Today I am calm." — agora ela está tranquila.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I sent the report yesterday." Yesterday means…
items.why: Yesterday = ontem, o dia antes de hoje.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The boxes are ___. We can send them now."
items.why: Ready = pronto: as caixas estão prontas para enviar.

items.q: "We met two days ago." Ago means…
items.why: Ago = atrás: dois dias atrás, no passado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The customers were very ___ with the fast delivery."
items.why: Happy = feliz: os clientes ficaram felizes.

items.q: "We had the meeting last week." Last week means…
items.why: Last week = semana passada, a semana antes desta.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The delivery was on time." On time means…
items.why: On time = no horário, na hora certa.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the order." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We ran out of boxes yesterday." To run out of means to…
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem, acabar o estoque.

items.q: "Please follow up with the customer today." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar seguimento, entrar em contato de novo para verificar.

items.q: "The truck showed up late last week." To show up means to…
items.why: Show up = aparecer, chegar.
